raw_text: Smart Shield: monitor Cloudflare changelog. Always check editability before attempting to enable/disable Argo. Set up billing notifications. Combine with Tiered Cache. Use in production only; disable for dev/staging. Monitor analytics (500+ requests/48h). Handle errors gracefully; test changes in staging. Use TypeScript SDK; implement retry logic. Document zone settings. Enterprise+ and valid billing/payment required. Check permissions, restrictions, holds; contact support if unclear. Never modify if `editable:false`. API rate limit: 1200 req/5 min; use exponential backoff. Metrics latency 1–5 minutes; proxied traffic only.
